anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex curve with a broad radius fitting the anterior-dorsal cranial margin.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, conical rostrum with a thick pixel base and rapid tapering to the anterior point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the junction where the melon slope meets the rostrum's superior boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Vibrant cyan-teal luminescent-style patterning across the mid-lateral flank and dorsal-cranial ridges.
